description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield as an enchantment due to Enchanted Evening, it and Composer of Spring trigger.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Composer of Spring trigger, putting Azorius Chancery onto the battlefield from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
